自动排表只会从这里的名单选人，会尽量平均分配，也避免同一个人同一天做两个岗位。不: Auto-fill only picks people from these lists, spreads turns evenly and avoids one person doing two roles on the same day. Inactive members are greyed out and skipped by auto-fill (you can still type them in). Adding or removing names saves automatically.
日期、负责组、状态和公开显示只有行政组可以改。要换日期，请用「⇄ 申请交换节目」: Only the executive team can change the date, group, status and visibility. To move a program to another date, use "⇄ Request program swap".
只有行政组可以改；要换日期请用「申请交换节目」: Executive team only. To change the date, use "Request program swap"
只有行政组可以改负责组: Only the executive team can change the group in charge
你只能修改自己组负责的节目。: You can only edit programs run by your own group.
只有行政组可以新增节目。: Only the executive team can add programs.
请填写岗位和姓名。: Please fill in the role and name.
系统忙碌中，请稍后再试。: The system is busy. Please try again shortly.
不能审核自己的 Claim，请由另一位财政或查账审核。: You can't review your own claim. Please ask another treasurer or auditor.
Claim 金额不正确，请先更正。: The claim amount is invalid. Please correct it first.
只有建立这份报告的人或行政组可以修改。: Only the report's creator or the executive team can edit it.
只有建立这份报告的人或行政组可以删除。: Only the report's creator or the executive team can delete it.
这个功能只能在 Apps Script 编辑器里运行。: This function can only be run from the Apps Script editor.
忘记密码可以按「忘记密码」，系统会把重设密码的链接寄到你的 Email。: Forgot your password? Tap "Forgot password" and a reset link will be emailed to you.
输入你注册时用的 Email。系统会把重设密码的链接寄给你，点链接就可以设定新密: Enter the email you registered with. We'll email you a reset link; open it to set a new password.
填你注册时用的 Email。重设密码的链接会寄到这个信箱，几分钟内没收到请看垃圾: Enter the email you registered with. The reset link is sent there; check spam if it doesn't arrive in a few minutes.
确定要帮这个账号重设密码吗？系统会把重设密码的链接寄到对方的 Email。: Reset this account's password? A reset link will be emailed to them.
如果这个 Email 有账号，重设密码的链接已经寄出，请到信箱查看（也看看垃圾邮: If this email has an account, a reset link has been sent. Please check your inbox (and spam).
注册失败：请检查姓名、组别和届别（只能申请当届或下一届）。: Registration failed: check your name, group and term (current or next term only).
这个功能还在搬移中，暂时不能用。: This feature is still being moved to the new system.
请输入新密码（至少 8 个字符），设定好后用新密码登入。: Enter a new password (at least 8 characters), then log in with it.
新密码已设定，请用新密码登入。: New password saved. Please log in with it.
网络连线有问题，请稍后再试。: Network problem, please try again later.
找不到你的账号资料，请联系管理员。: Your account details were not found. Please contact an admin.
